items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: always used to come down there and sit in and play piano with us all the time

ctx.x: Right. But he always wanted to be

included in that particular set up, and he probably wanted to change his style to fit what they were doing. I think that's the only thing, what it actually amounted to, because when I heard him after he got, you know, big, I said this is not the guy that I've known, always used to come down there and sit in and play piano with us all the time. But he wasn't doing nothing, in my estimation.

A lot of people just go in there and at the Apollo giblet, Thelonius Monk (unintelligible), that son of a bitch can't play nothing. He didn't know I was a musician, (Unintelligible). But the guy didn't know I was a musician. I'm sitting there listening.
